result.summary: Riverside Works says the approved toilet and cistern replacement is finished. It says it attached an invoice and a photo, but neither is in the CRM. I moved the ticket to closeout and asked the contractor to send the invoice and photo again. I asked the tenant to confirm the toilet works. The ticket is on hold with a follow-up in 2 days. Nothing can be paid until a human checks the invoice against the approved quote. The quote amount isn't in the CRM either.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 034 is a completion report (classifier: completion_report 0.97, autonomy auto). The landlord approved the quote in events 019 and 021, and works were booked for 15/08 (event 027). The next step is closeout: check the invoice and get the tenant to confirm. The invoice isn't visible, so the contractor is the right person to ask. That is better than escalating straight away.

alternatives_considered.option: Escalate to a human now for the invoice check
alternatives_considered.why_not: There is no invoice to check yet. The contractor can fix that by sending it again. Escalating now would only stall the job.
Neither the tenant nor any visible evidence confirms the work is done, and the invoice hasn't been checked.

alternatives_considered.option: No action / return to auto mode
alternatives_considered.why_not: The invoice isn't visible, so someone has to ask for it. Otherwise closeout would stall.
